command:
set -euo pipefail
printf '%s\n' '--- unit ---'
systemctl --user cat frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service --no-pager
printf '%s\n' '--- effective ---'
systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart --no-pager
printf '%s\n' '--- dropins ---'
find "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service.d" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true
printf '%s\n' '--- final tree ---'
for f in "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_final_runtime.py" "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_full_runtime.py" "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_full_integration.py"; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then sha256sum "$f"; else echo "MISSING $f"; fi; done
printf '%s\n' '--- final imports/patch ---'
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.home()/'.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_final_runtime.py'
if p.is_file():
    s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
    for needle in ('import voice_full_runtime as base','import voice_full_integration as vfi','import realtime_gespraech as rt','base.patch_runtime()','def patch_final_runtime'):
        print(needle, needle in s)
PY
